players.scale: 22nd edition, 8–12 April 2026, in Oscar Niemeyer's Biennial pavilion, Ibirapuera Park: more than 180 galleries, design studios and cultural institutions, mostly Brazilian with some international galleries. The design sector has grown from 23 stands at its 2016 start to 64; a new DesignNOW section showed ten independent Brazilian designers. No visitor or sales total disclosed. A second fair, SP-Arte Rotas, runs in August.

players.scale: 24th year, Centro Banamex, closing 8 February 2026; more than 75 visiting museum groups, many from the US and Canada; a gallery news page announced 241 exhibitors for 2026 (headline only). Pace sold almost its whole Kylie Manning solo stand at the preview, the triptych going to a Mexican collection; Sean Kelly priced Abramović and Wiley at $20,000–300,000; Kouri + Corrao $500–40,000; Kates-Ferri $1,500–10,000; Ambar Quijano covered its stand at the preview.
players.edge: The region's most international fair, in a week that also carries Material and Salón Acme. Dealers report fewer US collectors than in past years (Kates) but Americans attending ‘partly to escape the political climate at home’ (Kelly), and a large rise in international visitors over six to eight years (Torres).
